items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: That's right, that's who he was playing with.

ctx.x: That was one thing I forgot to tell you. Well, I first, you see, when I first started playing with him, I was just playing by ear, what's it called. Well, after I began to play with these bands, some of these bands used to use music, you see. And playing with those bands, they would play pieces that, I mean, my ear just wasn't good enough to catch the chords, you see. So, uh, uh, I said, well, I'm gonna try to learn something about the music anyhow, so I'll be able to make the right chords. So, I went to John…
Was he with Celestan in those days, I guess? Who's that? Was he with Celestan?

That's right, that's who he was playing with. So, there was a violin player, I heard about it, I said, well, I thought violin players would know something about any string instrument. That's the way I thought it anyway.
